# Scalize Systems

> Scalize Systems reimagines product and software development lifecycles for growth-stage companies, designing and building the workflows, decision frameworks, and handoffs that work for humans and agents.

Traditional product development processes weren’t designed for AI agents. I help growth-stage product and engineering teams redesign decisions, workflows, and handoffs so people and agents can work together with clear accountability.

Founder: [Katie Robblee](https://www.scalizesystems.com/about)

Contact: katie@scalizesystems.com, or book an intro call at https://calendly.com/katie-scalizesystems/30-mins

## Selected results from consulting and in-house leadership roles

- 30× faster releases: Diagnosed an outdated architecture and redesigned product workflows for a full product rewrite at a B2B SaaS startup, reaching full CI/CD and a 30x improvement in release frequency.
- 50% faster time to first value: Improved design and onboarding in the rewritten product, so customers reached first value 50% faster than with the previous product.
- 25% lower operating costs: Led product strategy and delivery for a shared customer acquisition platform that replaced seven legacy systems across more than 100 brands.

## Agents work differently than humans. Have you changed your processes to work with them?

People bring experience, relationships, and accumulated context to their work. For agents, you have to design how that context is supplied—and how their work connects to yours.

- People: “I remember why we decided that.” History from meetings, past projects, and experience stays with the person.
  Agents: Put the relevant context within reach. Supply current decisions, constraints, and supporting evidence at the point of work.
- People: “I know who to ask.” Relationships help people find answers and navigate conflicting information.
  Agents: Define where answers come from. Specify authoritative sources, decision owners, and a route to a human when information conflicts.
- People: “I’ll pick up where I left off.” People carry an understanding of progress, open questions, and recent changes.
  Agents: Preserve state between runs. Record what is complete, what changed, and what remains unresolved so work can resume reliably.
- People: “This needs a conversation.” A person can recognize an exception and negotiate the next step with colleagues.
  Agents: Design the pause and the handoff. Set decision boundaries, escalation triggers, and the information a human needs to take over.
- People: “I can work through these one at a time.” Processes are often paced around individual capacity and sequential handoffs.
  Agents: Rethink how the work is divided. Identify tasks agents can run in parallel, checks to automate, and points that need human judgment.

Adding an agent changes who does the work. Redesigning the process changes how well it works. [Explore how I work](https://www.scalizesystems.com/how-i-work)

## Services

- [Operating Diagnostic](https://www.scalizesystems.com/services#operating-diagnostic): A two to three week engagement that maps how your organization operates across the PDLC and SDLC, where effort is going, which work belongs to humans, agents, or both, and where the friction is.
- [Build Engagement](https://www.scalizesystems.com/services#build-engagement): A three to six month engagement scoped directly from the diagnostic findings, producing human and agent ready processes, decision frameworks, and an executable plan to scale and measure reimagined processes across the organization.

## Templates and Tools

- [Pressure Testing AI-Enabled Processes](https://cdn.sanity.io/files/z13orr0o/production/1d68da9d5527dc5e95220302af98890ef0b419f4.pdf): A five-step loop for improving one AI-enabled process at a time, run with the whole system in view.
- [AI RACI for Product and Engineering Teams](https://cdn.sanity.io/files/z13orr0o/production/e3700eaa228aefc594f0765fbe83d9c2d4116d54.xlsx): This RACI template gives teams a way to negotiate ownership over the roles AI has reshaped, from reviewing AI-generated code to catching a hallucination before it ships. It gives facilitators a starting list of jobs and allows teams to visualize where ownership is still unclaimed.
- [Graduated Human-in-the-Loop Eval Ownership Model](https://cdn.sanity.io/files/z13orr0o/production/2985dbcae89550c626f230d169000fccc4392002.pdf): This framework gives senior PMs a structured approach for reintroducing that friction deliberately, through human-in-the-loop evaluation work. It gives junior PMs a clear picture of what is expected at each stage and what evidence demonstrates readiness to advance. It gives organizational leaders a model for what skill-building in an AI-native product team actually requires.

- [How AI agents are changing the product development lifecycle](https://www.usertesting.com/resources/podcast/ai-agents-and-product-development-lifecycle): Insights Unlocked, hosted by Mike Mace. Learn how AI agents are transforming product development, why customer discovery matters more than ever, and how teams can adopt AI successfully.
